fact: The ambush takes place at the end of a pier on the Darklake Docks.
source_quote: At the end of a pier on the Darklake Docks
subject: Darklake Docks

fact: Werz is a Duergar merchant who was standing alone at the pier when the assassination attempt began.
source_quote: they spotted a Duergar merchant standing alone
subject: Werz

fact: Assassin 1 is one of two masked, hooded assassins who suddenly became visible beside the merchant.
source_quote: Two figures suddenly shimmered into visibility beside him: masked, hooded assassins
subject: assassin 1

fact: Assassin 2 is the other of the two masked, hooded assassins who appeared beside the merchant.
source_quote: Two figures suddenly shimmered into visibility beside him: masked, hooded assassins
subject: assassin 2

fact: The two assassins drove glowing blades into the merchant Werz.
source_quote: who drove glowing blades into the merchant with vicious precision
subject: assassination attempt

fact: Thorin expressed immediate interest in acquiring the assassins' glowing weapons.
source_quote: Thorin immediately coveted the glowing weapons
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin's player's out-of-game anecdote about fireflies led to the party naming their tactic 'Firefly Tactics'.
source_quote: Thorin's player's out-of-game firefly anecdote leads to the group name 'Firefly Tactics'
subject: Thorin

fact: The party charged the assassins immediately upon spotting the attack.
source_quote: Without hesitation, the party charged
subject: party charges

fact: Gyrgum attempted to shove an assassin into the water but failed a contested Athletics check.
source_quote: Gyrgum rushed forward and tried to shove one of the killers into the water, but the assassin held his ground
subject: Gyrgum shove attempt

fact: Daz dealt nine points of magical damage to one of the assassins.
source_quote: Daz unleashed a torrent of magical energy that tore into one of the attackers for nine damage
subject: Daz magical attack

fact: Daz moved closer to the combatants to avoid being separated from them if the assassin turned invisible again.
source_quote: Daz moves closer in case the assassin turns invisible again
subject: Daz positioning

fact: One assassin attempted to strike Gyrgum with a glowing blade but missed on a natural 1.
source_quote: One assassin retaliates against Gyrgum with a glowing blade but misses on a natural 1
subject: assassin counterattack miss

fact: The merchant Werz screamed for help, disengaged, and ran away from the combat.
source_quote: The merchant screams for help, disengages, and runs
subject: Werz disengagement

fact: Zalthir conjured a 15-foot sphere of impenetrable magical darkness over the pier.
source_quote: Zalthir conjured a sphere of impenetrable magical darkness over the pier
subject: Zalthir darkness

fact: Zalthir's first attack roll against the assassin was a natural 1.
source_quote: His first strike missed on a natural 1
subject: Zalthir first strike

fact: Zalthir spent a focus point to make a second attack and killed one of the assassins.
source_quote: but he spent a focus point to strike again and killed one assassin outright
subject: Zalthir killing blow

fact: One assassin is dead, killed by Zalthir's strike.
source_quote: killed one assassin outright
subject: assassin 1

fact: Thorin used a Precision Attack superiority die to turn a miss into a hit on the remaining assassin, dealing six damage.
source_quote: Thorin salvaged a miss with a Precision Attack and landed a precise blow for six damage
subject: Thorin precision attack

fact: Gyrgum struck the remaining assassin with radiant energy channeled through his mace, dealing two points of damage.
source_quote: Gyrgum channeled radiant holy energy through his mace
subject: Gyrgum radiant strike

fact: The GM questioned the rules for True Strike regarding Gyrgum's attack but conceded that the rules had changed.
source_quote: The GM briefly questioned whether True Strike includes the attack, then conceded the rules had changed
subject: Gyrgum true strike

fact: Daz targeted the assassin with Scorching Ray at disadvantage because he could not see the target in the magical darkness.
source_quote: Magic Missile can't target a creature he can't see in magical darkness, so he targets squares with Scorching Ray at disadvantage
subject: Daz scorching rays

fact: Daz's rays dealt four and six damage, killing the final assassin.
source_quote: Rays for four and six damage finish the assassin
subject: Daz killing rays

fact: The second assassin is dead, killed by Daz's Scorching Rays.
source_quote: When the darkness lifted, both assassins lay dead
subject: assassin 2

fact: The glowing blades used by the assassins vanished, dissolving back into psychic energy.
source_quote: The glowing blades they had wielded had vanished entirely, dissolving back into the psychic energy from which they had been conjured
subject: blades dissolve

fact: The glowing blades used in the attack are psionic weapons that do not persist after the wielder's death.
source_quote: revealing it to be a psionic weapon
subject: glowing blades

fact: Gyrgum healed the wounds of the merchant Werz with a quick prayer.
source_quote: Gyrgum knelt beside the wounded merchant and spoke a quick prayer, closing the man's wounds
subject: Werz healing

fact: Werz invited the party to meet him at the Shattered Spire to receive a reward.
source_quote: invited them to meet him at the Shattered Spire to receive a proper reward
subject: Werz invitation

fact: Werz claims he does not know why he was targeted by assassins.
source_quote: Werz, claimed to have no idea why he had been targeted
subject: Werz

fact: The reason for the assassination attempt on Werz is currently unknown.
source_quote: Werz: 'I have no idea why I was targeted by assassins.'
subject: Werz motivation

fact: Werz's clan affiliation is unknown.
source_quote: Werz's clan affiliation remains unknown
subject: Werz clan
